gloss: to get up, to rise, to sit up

definitions.explanation: To raise oneself from a lying or sitting position to standing.
To raise one's upper body from a lying position to a sitting position.

definitions.gloss: to recover, to get back up
definitions.explanation: To recover from a setback or difficulty (figurative use).

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、なかなか{起|お}き{上|あ}がれない。
examples.english: In the morning, I can't easily get up.

examples.japanese: ベッドから{起|お}き{上|あ}がって{窓|まど}を{開|あ}けた。
examples.english: I got up from bed and opened the window.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んでも{何度|なんど}でも{起|お}き{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: No matter how many times I fall, I get back up.
examples.notes: [Note: Figurative use meaning to recover from setbacks]

examples.japanese: ソファから{起|お}き{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I got up from the sofa.

examples.japanese: {目|め}が{覚|さ}めてもすぐに{起|お}き{上|あ}がれなかった。
examples.english: Even after waking up, I couldn't get up right away.

examples.japanese: ゆっくり{起|お}き{上|あ}がってください。
{病人|びょうにん}が{起|お}き{上|あ}がった。
{赤|あか}ちゃんがひとりで{起|お}き{上|あ}がれるようになった。
examples.english: The baby learned to sit up on its own.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}から{起|お}き{上|あ}がる{力|ちから}がない。

examples.english: I had such a high fever that I couldn't sit up, so I lay in bed all day.

examples.japanese: {倒産|とうさん}から{起|お}き{上|あ}がった。
{失敗|しっぱい}から{起|お}き{上|あ}がる{力|ちから}。
examples.english: The strength to bounce back from failure.

examples.japanese: {不況|ふきょう}から{起|お}き{上|あ}がった{会社|かいしゃ}。

examples.english: I was able to get back on my feet from hardship.

notes:
{起|お}き{上|あ}がる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to get up or rise.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {起|お}きる (to get up) + {上|あ}がる (to rise) → to rise up

ASPECT (ている):
{起|お}き{上|あ}がっている indicates a state of being up (having risen).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ベッドから{起|お}き{上|あ}がる (get up from bed)
- {倒|たお}れても{起|お}き{上|あ}がる (get back up even when knocked down)
- ゆっくり{起|お}き{上|あ}がる (slowly get up)

RELATED EXPRESSION:
- {起|お}き{上|あ}がりこぼし: a roly-poly toy (tumbler doll that always rights itself)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {起|お}きる: to wake up, to get up (more general)
- {起|お}き{上|あ}がる emphasizes the physical motion of rising

[Register: Neutral]
